title: RevokeCredentialsPayload
description: Payload schema for the REVOKE_CREDENTIALS intent. Suspends or revokes credentials, API tokens, or session keys for an affected principal.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this revocation request.

affected_principal.description: Identity whose credentials are being revoked (e.g. 'agent_research', 'external_user', 'service_account_xyz').

action.description: Suspend (reversible), revoke (permanent), rotate (replace with new credential).

reason.description: Justification for the action. Required for audit; vague reasons trigger AUDIT_REVIEW_REQUEST.

requested_by.description: Agent or principal initiating the revocation.

duration_minutes.description: For 'suspend': duration in minutes. null = until manual reinstatement. Ignored for 'revoke' and 'rotate'.

linked_event_id.description: Reference to a SECURITY_EVENT that motivated the revocation.

scope.description: Specific credentials or tokens to act on. If omitted, applies to all credentials for the principal.

notification_required.description: Whether to notify the affected principal. False is reserved for active-incident scenarios.

playbook_ref.description: Path to the incident response playbook driving this action, if any.

allOf.description: If action is 'suspend' and duration_minutes is positive, that's a temporary lock; if null, manual reinstatement is required.

examples.reason: Unapproved bulk export attempt of 120,000 customer records; investigation pending.
